text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Hello? Is that you, ya li'l runts? Ya<n>watched the
race, yeah?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I did my best, but the lady racing<n>against me was
real good too, right?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: She's the same as me.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Several nights after the spring Tenno<n>Sho...
Comin' in, Creek.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Tamtam! I'm so sorry for the<n>other day. My
emotions got the better<n>of me...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
S'okay. What happens in a race<n>stays in the race.
Besides, I was the<n>one who provoked ya.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I totally screwed up by sayin' what I<n>did. I fired ya
up so much, you<n>became the star.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Remember what I said in the waitin'<n>room before
the race?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
And I'll whomp that trainer lurkin'<n>behind ya so
bad they'll never be the<n>same.

I shouldn't've said that. I was tryin'<n>to sabotage
your future.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
But I lit a fire under ya, and the kind<n>Creek was
gone.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
choice_data_list: What's she talking about, Super Creek?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I wouldn't have cared if you were<n>just trying to
provoke me, but...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I couldn't let you hurt Trainer's<n>future.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Because I will do everything in my<n>power to make
sure my trainer<n>becomes the best in the world.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: That's a dream that I won't budge<n>on.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
It hit me when I saw your angry face<n>after the
race...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: It was like my mom's face when she<n>gets angry.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
The face of somebody tryin' to<n>protect their kid
from some schmuck<n>tryin' to crush their dreams.

I thought the two of you were a ditzy<n>duo, but I was
wrong.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
You're family. I never realized it, but<n>you're racin'
for somethin' just as<n>precious as I am.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry for pickin' a fight. You two<n>are the real
deal.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Tamtam... I should be the one<n>apologizing, but thank
you for saying<n>that. ♪

Oh, I know! Let's have dinner<n>together! You
haven't eaten yet, have<n>you?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I'll make sure to call your mommy to<n>let her know,
okay?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Wait, my mom?! Ya don't gotta call<n>her when she's
all the way over in<n>Osaka!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Sigh... What am I s'posed to do withya?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
But I'll definitely join you for dinner!<n>Can't miss
out on your tasty cookin'!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
After a fun dinner together, Super<n>Creek and
Tamamo Cross are back<n>to being best friends.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Phew, thanks for the chow. Anyway,<n>I'm sure your
race against Oguri<n>won't be as scrappy as ours.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
She might be a li'l spacey, but you<n>two have fun
out there, yeah?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Hehe, okay! I'll do just that.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The fierce look definitely doesn't suit<n>Super Creek.
I hope she has an<n>amicable race this time around.
